title: Integrating Electroencephalography Source Localization and Residual Convolutional Neural Network for Advanced Stroke Rehabilitation.
summary: EEG source-localization representations and a residual CNN distinguished motor-imagery signals in acute-stroke participants. The result concerns signal classification, not improved stroke recovery.
ai_technology: Primary full text checked: Methods report 50 participants and held-out signal partitions; Results compare localization approaches and sensor-space baselines.
